messages:
Maya: Quick one — where's the canonical dashboard for GPU utilization (SM%, mem, KV cache, batch size) for prod pools? Also who owns the alerts for high SM% / KV evictions? Need to QA a rollout, ping.

Kevin: Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/gpu-overview?orgId=1 — useful panels: SM% (panel id=4), Memory (7), KV hitrate (12), Batch size (15). Owners: @Dylan for pool-level dashboards, @Sree owns alert rules. :point_up:

Dylan: If you want per-pool breakdown, open the 'GPU Pool Heatmap' panel. For KV details check metrics kvcache.evictions/sec and kvcache.hitrate.

Maya: Thanks. Any quick log/trace queries I should run to correlate spikes? Want to capture traces during a 5m canary.

OpsBot: Alert fired: kvcache.evictions/sec > 50 for pool 'shared-prod' — triggered at 2025-11-12T09:32:10Z. Incident ref: INC-5421.

Kevin: For PromQL to watch SM% over short windows try:```
avg by (pool) (rate(gpu_sm_utilization_seconds_total[1m])) * 100
```
And a Loki example to find eviction logs:```
{app="runtime", pool="shared-prod"} |= "evict" | line_format "{{.ts}} {{.msg}}"
```
Those will give traces/logs to correlate with the grafana panels.

Sree: Alerts live in repo infra-monitoring at ops/alerts/gpu.yaml. Current thresholds: sm_util > 85% for 5m, kv_evictions > 20/min for 2m. Happy to adjust thresholds — share the canary traffic profile and I can tweak.

Maya: I'll kick off the canary in ~20m and post screenshots + trace ids. Can you @Dylan to watch the pool? Thanks :thumbsup:

Dylan: @Maya on it — I'll watch traces and KV metrics, will ack if I see anything unusual.
